notifications.title: Enable Notifications
notifications.description: Receive push notifications about important updates

status.unsupported: Push notifications are not supported in your browser

appleInstall.title: Install App for Notifications
appleInstall.description: To enable push notifications on iOS, you need to install this app to your Home Screen.
appleInstall.step1: Tap the Share button (usually at the bottom or top of Safari)
appleInstall.step2: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen"
appleInstall.step3: Tap "Add" in the top right corner
appleInstall.step4: Open the app from your Home Screen
